tools.description: Post real-time shoot status updates, weather alerts, equipment issues, and end-of-day summaries to the project Lark channel.

actions.description: Post a status update to the project channel at each checkpoint (arrival, per-shot, transitions, wrap).

parameters.channel_id: string — project channel ID from pre-production output
parameters.mention_users: array — Lark user IDs to tag (e.g., project manager on issue alerts)
parameters.thread_id: string | null — reply to an existing thread if continuing a discussion

actions.description: Share the raw file inventory or drone flight log as an attachment in the project channel.

parameters.file_path: string — path to the file on Google Drive or local storage
parameters.file_name: string — display name for the attachment
parameters.comment: string — message to accompany the file

tools.description: Upload raw files from the shoot to the project folder structure on Google Drive.

actions.description: Upload a raw video, drone, or photo file to the appropriate project subfolder.

parameters.file_name: string — file name following EEVL naming convention
parameters.file_path: string — local path to the raw file
parameters.content_type: string — video/mp4, video/quicktime, image/x-sony-arw, image/x-canon-cr3, image/dng

actions.description: Upload multiple raw files in batch to the appropriate subfolder.

parameters.files: array — list of objects with file_name, file_path, and content_type

actions.description: Verify uploaded files by listing contents of a project subfolder.

tools.description: Update the shoot-day ClickUp task with real-time status, equipment issues, and completion state.

actions.description: Update the shoot-day task status and add comments for shoot progress tracking.

parameters.task_id: string — shoot-day ClickUp task ID from pre-production schedule

custom_fields.shots_planned: integer — total shots on the list
custom_fields.equipment_issues: string — summary of any equipment problems

actions.description: Add a progress comment to the shoot-day task for timeline documentation.
